purpose: Whole-suite before/after evidence for the Config/test-baseline.json known_failures entries removed by the module-isolation change (#429). It covers the removals outside the files that change edited (PcaiNativeArtifactPairing, PcaiGpuContracts) and, for context, the edited ones.

run.command: Invoke-Pester over Tests/Unit with Filter.Tag = Portable (the tier Config/test-baseline.json records), one child pwsh per tree, TestResult NUnit3, Output None: Import-Module Pester -MinimumVersion 5.6.1; Set-Location <tree>; New-PesterConfiguration; Run.Path Tests/Unit; Filter.Tag Portable
run.treeExtraction: git archive of each commit into an empty directory, so neither tree carries .git

before.description: origin/main, the parent of the change

after.description: claude/test-module-isolation at the PR #429 head; squash-merged into main as b2026871 with identical content for these files

Run alone in the after tree it passes 83 of 83.
